die_height_mm.confirming_evidence: A public Blackwell teardown, mask analysis, or floorplan measurement places the long die dimension within the derived interval.
die_height_mm.falsifying_evidence: A public die measurement places the Blackwell logic die's long axis outside 31mm to 33mm, or NVIDIA clarifies that reticle-limit refers to a different geometry.
die_height_mm.methodology: Claim gate conversion: Interpret NVIDIA's description of each Blackwell logic die as reticle limit against ASML's reported 26mm by 33mm maximum standard full exposure field. Use the long field axis as the model's height coordinate and assign a 31mm to 33mm interval around a 32mm base to reflect that reticle-limit does not prove the design occupies the full field. This is a derived interval, not a reported or teardown-measured die dimension. Applied multiplier 1 from mm to mm.

die_width_mm.confirming_evidence: A public Blackwell teardown, mask analysis, or floorplan measurement places the short die dimension within the derived interval.
die_width_mm.falsifying_evidence: A public die measurement places the Blackwell logic die's short axis outside 25.5mm to 26mm, or NVIDIA clarifies that reticle-limit refers to a different geometry.
die_width_mm.methodology: Claim gate conversion: Interpret NVIDIA's description of each Blackwell logic die as reticle limit against ASML's reported 26mm by 33mm maximum standard full exposure field. Use the short field axis as the model's width coordinate and retain a 0.5mm analyst allowance below the maximum. This is a derived interval, not a reported or teardown-measured die dimension. Applied multiplier 1 from mm to mm.

edge_exclusion_mm.methodology: Illustrative unusable wafer edge used by the gross-die approximation.

wafer_diameter_mm.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA or TSMC process-integration document explicitly identifies Blackwell 4NP as a 300mm wafer process.
wafer_diameter_mm.falsifying_evidence: NVIDIA or TSMC identifies a non-300mm wafer format for Blackwell 4NP, or NVIDIA identifies a different foundry process for this design.
wafer_diameter_mm.methodology: Claim gate conversion: Combine NVIDIA's reported Blackwell 4NP process with TSMC disclosures that its 4nm production uses a 12-inch fab and that TSMC labels the 12-inch GIGAFAB profile as 300mm capacity. Treat 300mm as the nominal semiconductor wafer format, not as an arithmetic conversion of 12 inches. This does not identify Blackwell's fab location, wafer starts, yield, or production volume. Applied multiplier 1 from mm to mm.

references.notes: This prior-quarter company total checks scale only. It cannot allocate wafers by node, customer, or product and does not replace synthetic Blackwell wafer starts.

methodology.gross_dies_per_wafer: Circular wafer area divided by effective die and scribe area, less an analytical edge-loss term.
methodology.hbm_yield: Known-good memory dies divided by dies per stack, then multiplied by stack-assembly and final-test yields.
methodology.logic_yield: Negative-binomial random-defect yield multiplied by wafer-sort yield and performance-bin share.
methodology.package_output: The minimum of logic-die, HBM-stack, and assembly-start package equivalents, multiplied by final assembly yield.

scenario.name: Blackwell wafer, HBM, and package conversion
scenario.notes: Product topology uses primary NVIDIA and Micron documents. All process and capacity inputs remain synthetic. Revision blackwell-wafer-format-2026-07-19: Replace only the synthetic nominal logic-wafer diameter with the exact-scope derived 300mm claim. Wafer starts, die dimensions, yields, binning, HBM conversion, and package throughput remain synthetic. Revision blackwell-reticle-geometry-2026-07-19: Replace the remaining synthetic Blackwell logic-die width and height with bounded derived estimates from NVIDIA's reticle-limit description and ASML's standard 26mm by 33mm maximum exposure field. These are not teardown measurements. Wafer starts, defect/yield/binning, scribe/edge, HBM conversion, and package throughput remain synthetic.
